title: REOPD: Reliability-Adaptive Reward Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Reward-extrapolation methods such as ExOPD amplify the teacher-reference log-likelihood ratio to move beyond direct imitation, but apply a single global coefficient $\lambda$ to every token. This can drive the student to fit extreme peaks in the implicit reward, causing reward hacking and unstable training, and the optimal $\lambda$ varies across domains, requiring costly sweeps. We propose REOPD, a reliability-adaptive reward extrapolation framework for OPD. REOPD combines a token-level compatibility weight with a batch-level adaptive budget, yielding a token-wise coefficient $\lambda_{b,t}=1+\gamma_b q_t$ that preserves teacher alignment while selectively extrapolating along reliable teacher-reference directions. translated_title: REOPD：面向在线策略蒸馏的可靠性自适应奖励外推方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11698v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在教师模型的密集词级监督下，基于学生自身的轨迹进行训练。奖励外推方法（如ExOPD）通过放大教师参考的对数似然比，以超越直接模仿，但对每个词元应用单一的全局系数λ。这可能导致学生拟合隐式奖励中的极端峰值，引发奖励黑客问题和训练不稳定，且最优λ在不同领域间变化，需要昂贵的调参。我们提出REOPD，一种用于OPD的可靠性自适应奖励外推框架。REOPD结合了词级兼容性权重和批次级自适应预算，生成词元级系数λ_{b,t}=1+γ_b q_t，在保持教师对齐的同时，沿可靠的教师参考方向进行选择性外推。它不需要验证器、奖励模型、价值模型，或标准OPD之外的额外 rollout。REOPD在性能上优于现有方法。
tldr: REOPD提出了一种可靠性自适应的奖励外推框架，通过词级兼容性权重和批次级自适应预算，在不增加额外模型或计算开销的情况下，有效解决了在线策略蒸馏中单一全局系数导致的奖励黑客和训练不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: REOPD proposes a reliability-adaptive reward extrapolation framework that uses token-level compatibility weights and batch-level adaptive budgets to mitigate reward hacking and training instability in on-policy distillation, without requiring extra models or computational overhead.
